$Comment: Defense XP added to the Headless Horseman's hard daily Claim (the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily_Hard
table), on a server running MMO Skill Tree: the hard twin of Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily.
ContributesTo folds this roll into that table without touching its file, so the table's own pay
is tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, so the
table pays exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1. A roll with no
Chance always pays, and Amount is XP before any boost.
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily_Hard
